decisions.label: Roster neighbourhood (degrees)
decisions.note: How far either side of a kind's island's bearing its compass neighbourhood reaches: every other kind on one area while the neighbourhood has kinds, second areas only once it runs out (Ed, 2026-11-04: "Now that islands have fewer areas, we can have fewer (none?) repeats of creature types on an island, besides the island of the creature type itself"; the middle way). 0: the 2026-10-28 rule (every other kind on 2 areas); 180: the whole compass. Try it with ?island=fox. A new map: it reloads.
